text:
maria (PM): Hey all — putting up a short PRD for a 'Doc-First Quickstarts' initiative for review. Goal: 3 short quickstarts (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) that devs can complete end-to-end in a short time. Link: https://redwood/internal/doc-first-quickstarts (draft). Please focus on acceptance criteria, edge cases, and CI gating. Need eng + devex signoff by EOD Friday.

sam (eng): Looking now. Quick q: do we need to ship full infra templates for Private/on-prem? that's a big ask if we do.

maria (PM): Minimal templates only — docker-compose + tiny k8s helm snippets and a network checklist. Not full ops runbook.

anika (devex): I can author the examples + short walkthrough video. Recommend two language examples: python + node. Also we should include smoke-test prompts.

jasper (design): I can design a single-page checklist UI and small banner for the quickstart page. Can we limit flows to one page per quickstart?

laura (legal): Quick flag: make sure Private docs don't show insecure key storage. Add KMS/HSM recommended guidance and a security checklist callout before publish.

maria (PM): noted @laura. Drafted ACs below — please react with :thumbsup: or suggest edits.

```
AC-1: Three runnable quickstarts (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) with code samples for Python and Node.
AC-2: End-to-end smoke test: Hosted quickstart runs in <15 minutes on dev laptop; Dedicated <30 minutes; Private includes explicit network/config checklist and may take longer.
AC-3: Example prompts + expected output snippets; include one test for long-context (>4k tokens) and defined fallback behavior (truncate vs. chunking).
AC-4: Security guidance: KMS/HSM recommendation, explicit DO NOT STORE SECRETS in repo, example of secure env var usage.
AC-5: Console screenshots and a one-page checklist component for the quickstart flow.
AC-6: Docs-as-spec requirement: all runnable examples live in /examples/quickstarts in repo. Example PRs must include a test that runs the example once.
AC-7: CI gating: Hosted + Dedicated examples run in CI by default; Private example present but skipped in CI unless FLAG_PRIVATE=true.
```

sam (eng): ACs look good. Technical note: KV cache warmup causes first-request latency variance on some models. Recommend an explicit note and a fallback code snippet to handle cache cold starts. I'll add the snippet.

anika (devex): For the CI gating, can we have a matrix that only runs Private examples in an integration pipeline (manual) or when FLAG_PRIVATE=true? don't want on-prem infra required for every PR.

maria (PM): Agreed — AC-7 captures that but I'll call out integration pipeline/manual trigger in the PR.

docbot: Automated check: PRD draft references /examples/quickstarts but examples dir not present in repo. Reminder created: add examples folder and update CODEOWNERS to include @devex.

maria (PM): Adding that to tasks. Proposed timeline: PRD merged Mon, engineering implementation + examples by Thu, docs + video + design assets by next Tue. Is that realistic?

sam (eng): Tight but doable if templates are minimal. I'll allocate time; can hit MVP by Thu if we scope templates to minimal docker/helm snippets.

jasper (design): I can deliver the one-page checklist + screenshots by Fri EOD.

laura (legal): Quick review ok, but require security blurb before publish.

maria (PM): Great — I'll update the PRD with AC-7, infra notes, and the CODEOWNERS change. @sam @anika will pair on the CI gating. Thanks :thumbsup:

anika (devex): I'll start the Python + Node smoke-test snippets today. Ping me to review examples.

sam (eng): @maria leaving a TODO in the PR for me to add the KV cache warmup snippet.

maria (PM): Done. I'll mark thread resolved when PRD edits merged. Milestone: milestone/doc-first-quickstarts.

sam (eng): :eyes: watching for PR.

docbot: Reminder set: follow-up review in 48 hours if no activity.
